verdict.rationale: DPMA offers online patent and trade mark search databases (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister) and e-filing tools (DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAdirektPro). A natural-language or conversational interface is a plausible feature for such services, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows natural-language commands, an AI assistant, or conversational operation; the documented routes are web forms, downloadable filing software, and paper or fax submission.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
